title: efficient matrix-free gauss-newton traveltime tomography on full-metric deformed grids
summary: First-arrival traveltime tomography provides a computationally efficient means of imaging subsurface velocity structure, while boundary-conforming deformed grids allow rugged topography to be represented without abandoning a logically structured mesh. In matrix-free Gauss-Newton inversion, however, the linearized full-metric Eikonal transport and its transpose must be applied repeatedly at a fixed background model.
